create_s3_logger: create an S3 logger instance with bucket name, region, and AWS credentials for logging events
run_log_event: run the S3 logger log_event method to write a JSON payload to an S3 bucket object
run_async_log_event: run the async S3 logger log_event wrapper to write a JSON payload to S3 asynchronously
build_s3_object_key: build an S3 object key string from path, prefix, start time, and file name components
review_s3_logger_init: review the S3 logger initialization to verify AWS client configuration and environment variable resolution
